threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the Tube is a quick way to get around? Wait 'til you try catching a bus at peak hour—that's the real Hackney experience.
Caught the N37 last night, and a guy started arguing with a pigeon in the middle of the road. Not sure who was winning.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Sitting at the park, I saw a grandma teaching her grandson to skateboard while a group was setting up their open-air cinema. Pure Neukölln vibes.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you'll find spontaneous parties in abandoned buildings, complete with local DJs spinning vinyl. It's not just a party; it's a whole experience of Berlin's DIY culture.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their patience at BART delays. A tourist's just confused; a local rolls their eyes and checks their phone.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus today, driver turned up the music—everyone started singing along. For a moment, chaos felt like a community jam session.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals love the vermut bars, but many of us prefer a quiet pastís at home instead of the crowded terraces.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can usually tell by the way they still attempt to pronounce 'Glòries' as 'glories' instead of just a quick 'glo-ree-es' like the locals.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You say 'hello' to random dogs in the park, but the owners just look at you like you’ve sprouted horns.
Caught a guy on the 78 last night explaining how he was banned from his local pub for singing too loudly. Must be a regular then.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found a hidden coffee shop in a converted laundromat, and they had the best flat whites in town. That’s when it clicked.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a combination of Turkish döner kiosks and hipster cafes coexisting, sometimes on the same block. It's a culinary love-hate square dance.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they instinctively look up the BART delays before getting out of bed. Tourist? They just grab their phone and head out clueless.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a glimpse of the Muni driver giving a thumbs up to a street performer outside the Civic Center. Only in SF do you see camaraderie like that!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plazas are for chillin', but locals know they’re just for dodging the street performers on weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at the bus stops—waiting with a map instead of checking the real-time screens.
